parallel.requirements: Recognized a clean-room reimplementation of csview 1.3.4, with no source lookup, no wrapping, and behavior inferred through CLI observation.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent began direct probing, then delegated seven behavioral dimensions to workflow children and planned a second critique phase while retaining final responsibility.
parallel.implementation: No buildable original implementation was produced; work consisted of probes, scratch files, and findings attempts.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The workflow returned result null and the official artifact contained only the original workspace files, including the provided executable, not a new source/build deliverable.
parallel.verification: The run gathered many behavioral observations, but no integrated reimplementation verification occurred before the official compile_failed evaluation.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The implementation, build script, final executable replacement, and workflow result were unfinished at timeout.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room reverse-engineering task and used only normal executable interaction and bundled documentation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent sequentially probed behavior without delegation or child handoffs.
serial.implementation: No original implementation files or buildable replacement were produced before timeout.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The submitted artifact likewise contained the original repository files and provided executable rather than a new compilable solution.
serial.verification: Serial observations covered many CLI/table cases, but there was no integrated implementation test because no implementation existed.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run timed out during exploration with no implementation and failed official compilation.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official completed evaluations are concordant both_fail outcomes: parallel and serial each failed compilation and passed 0 of 348 tests. Serial failed after a single-agent observation-heavy path with no implementation. Parallel failed after similar local probing plus a late seven-agent exploration workflow that was killed before returning a result; this is an adverse parallel process difference but not a pass/fail differential.
parallel_contributors: Late seven-agent exploration fan-out returned no aggregate result and consumed remaining budget.
No buildable original implementation was present in the submitted artifact.
serial_contributors: Single-agent trajectory also stayed in behavioral exploration and produced no buildable implementation.
Serial had no delegation or subagent lifecycle, so its failure is ordinary task noncompletion rather than parallel coordination.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both attempts omitted the central implementation and packaging obligation despite gathering behavior observations.
The compile_failed evaluator result follows from missing buildable source/artifact rather than a hidden test mismatch.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No official outcome difference; retained pattern is a supported parallel adverse process consequence, not an exclusive root cause.
